verses.1: And he said to me, “Son of Adam, when you find this treasure, go and tell the house of Israel.”
verses.2: And he opened his mouth, and he ate me up with that food.
verses.3: And He said to Adam, “In your belly you will eat, and from it you will give birth to this fruit that I have given you. It will be like grass in your mouth until you die.”
verses.4: And Adam said to his son, “Go and go to the house of Israel. And speak to them according to my words.”
verses.5: For you are not sent to a people who speak with eloquence and whose tongues are beautiful. You are sent to the house of Israel.
verses.6: Do not go to many nations with their thick speech and difficult languages. Their words cannot be heard unless you go there yourself. Then they will hear you.
verses.7: And in the house of Israel, they will not listen to you. They refuse to hear because they are too stubborn and hard-hearted. All the people of Israel are like that.
verses.8: Now, I have given you strong faces, for their purposes; and I have given you strong smiles, for their purposes as well.
verses.9: When Shamir was strong, I placed you in his place, so that you would not fear them or be afraid of them. For the house of Meri was already destroyed.
verses.10: And God said to Adam, “Take all these words I am about to speak to you, and remember them in your heart and on your lips.”
verses.11: And go to the valley, to your people. Speak to them and say to them, “Thus says the Lord Jehovah: Will they listen? Will they obey?”
verses.12: And a spirit carried me away, and I heard a loud noise behind me. It was the glory of Jehovah from His place.
verses.13: And the sound of the wings of the birds as they fly towards their mates; and the noise made by those who cry out in pain; and the loud noise of the chaos.
verses.14: And the Spirit carried me away, and I was taken away. I went away in the midst of my spirit’s burning. But the hand of Jehovah was strong upon me.
verses.15: And I will come down to the valley. It will be the time of spring. Those who live there will sit by the river Kavar. They will stay there for seven days, living among them from heaven.
verses.16: And there was a period of seven days. Then God spoke to me, saying:
verses.17: Son of man, you are being brought into the house of Israel. You will hear what they say, and you will be aware of them from me.
verses.18: In my words, the wicked will die and never be saved. You did not warn them about their evil ways. They continued to do evil, and thus they died. Their blood shall be shed by your hand.
verses.19: And you, who have sinned, will not be able to turn away from your sins. Your path of sin will lead you to death. But you, with your wicked heart, have been saved.
verses.20: And once again, the righteous remained righteous. But he committed sins, and I handed him over to his enemies. He died because he did not repent of his sins. They will never remember his righteous deeds that he had done. His blood will be shed by you.
verses.21: And you, because you have kept your promise, are righteous. You do not sin; you are righteous. And since you have kept your promise, your life will be blessed.
verses.22: And there was the hand of Jehovah upon me. He said to me, “Get up and go into the valley. There I will speak to you.”
verses.23: And I stood up and went towards the abyss. There, I saw the glory of Jehovah standing there, just as I had seen it on the river Kebar. And I covered my face with my hands.
verses.24: And a spirit entered me, and he stood on my feet. He spoke to me, saying, “Go and be confined within your house.”
verses.25: And you, son of Adam, you have been given heavy burdens to carry. They have forbidden you from leaving those places.
verses.26: And for your sake, I will go to them and we will be united. But they will not have anyone to help them, because Meri’s house is now empty.
verses.27: And when I speak to you, I open your mouth. You say to them, “Thus says the Lord Jehovah: He will hear; he will listen, and then he will stop.” For the house of Meri is gone.
